result:
Round 503 is implemented exactly as B's sketch, with no STOP. Typecheck, lint, scoped Biome and the covering tests all match B's expected values. The code-reviewer found nothing Medium or above.

**What changed:** the 7 granted files and nothing else.
- Three links now use `buildButtonClassName`: cart "Upgrade" in `app/routes/cart.tsx`, "Create a scene" in `app/routes/recordings.$productId.tsx`, and "Browse the Collection" in `app/components/home/StudioShowcase.tsx`.
- The new test `app/lib/__tests__/store-button-cleanup-2b3.test.tsx`.
- `docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`, the status line of doc 323, and the new doc 324.

The patch's sha256 matched B's, and it applied cleanly. The four file-integrity checks (B's frozen checks 1–4) all returned rc 0. I re-ran `git status` and checks 1, 2 and 4 as the very last step: still exactly these 7 entries, all rc 0.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run typecheck` | rc 0 |
| `npm run lint` | rc 0, 179 warnings (same as HEAD) |
| Biome on the 4 code/test files | rc 0, 6 warnings (all existed before) |
| Covering tests | 12 files, 115/115 passed; all 12 B2B3 tests present; slowest 433 ms (limit 2,500) |
| code-reviewer | 0 Critical/High/Medium, 1 Low, 3 Info, 9/10 |

**Reviewer findings, passed to B and not edited:**
- **Low:** doc 324's status line already says "C round 503 PASS" before C has run. That is the exact wording B required, and C checks it byte for byte, so I left it.
- **Info:**
  - one test only checks that each file calls the builder at least once (the exact classes are checked elsewhere);
  - the test's stub catalogue type can drift from the real API type;
  - doc 323's new status line drops the three bug ids, which makes them harder to grep for.
- **Architecture note:** this is the third stage in a row that writes `<Link className={buildButtonClassName(...)}>` by hand, and there is now a third copy of the tag scanner. The reviewer's advice is to decide on a `ButtonLink` wrapper and one shared scanner at the end of stage 2. Both are already tracked (SIG-R498, SIG-R501).

**Not run by me:**
- The full test suite, the build, `npm run verify`/`/check` and the BC1b test. The speed rules leave these to the root gate.
- Any browser check, including contrast. That is C's job (rows C0–C14).

**Process, stated plainly:**
- I read only the first 60 lines of each primitive before applying the patch.
- I read the pre-flight skill, `/check` and the A self-check lessons only after applying it. No lesson item needed action, and the report records this.

**Still open:**
- The real-backend check of the cart and recordings stays blocked ("backend unavailable in cloud").
- The Upgrade button colour question (SABA-Q-502-UPGRADE-VARIANT) is still waiting for Saba.
- `DESIGN_TOKENS.md` still lists the brand colour as teal. That file is outside my grants and is already tracked under DPG-DOCS-UPDATE.

The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-503.md`, and the logs are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-503/`.
